sources.title: Pre-built llamafiles | llamafile | Mozilla.ai Docs
sources.snippet: We provide pre-built llamafiles for a variety of models, so you can easily run them immediately without setup. The following table lists llamafiles bundled with the latest available version of the server (v0.10.*). The smaller the file is, the more easily it will run on your computer, even if no GPU is present (as a reference, Qwen3.5 0.8B Q8 generates text on a Raspberry Pi5 at ~8 tokens/sec).
